How it works

Convert watts and volts to amps for a simple DC or resistive single-phase calculation. Use the units shown in the calculator and review every assumption before using the result.

Formula

Amps = watts ÷ volts.

Worked example

1,200 W at 120 V equals 10 A.

Important assumptions

This tool is designed for planning and comparison. Real-world prices, manufacturer ratings, building requirements, lender terms, electrical codes, tolerances, and product specifications can vary.
